name: FraudEvidence
description: A single piece of evidence collected during the fraud investigation. Belongs to one FraudCase (ENT-043). Created by the Fraud Analyst (PER-054) during PH-065 (Case Creation) and PH-066 (Investigation). Evidence records are append-only — once created they cannot be modified or deleted (immutable audit trail obligation). All evidence records archived to WORM store on case closure. Introduced by JRN-005.

fields.name: case_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → FraudCase.case_id (ENT-043). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: evidence_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: transaction_data | device_data | communication_log | third_party_report | payment_warning_log | cop_result | customer_statement | vulnerability_assessment_record. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: description
fields.validation_rule: Required. Min 10 chars. Max 2,000 chars. Analyst narrative. Stored encrypted at rest.

fields.name: source_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. External system identifier (e.g. payment_intent_id, session_id, fps_reference). Max 256 chars.

fields.name: document_storage_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Internal document store URI for uploaded files (screenshots, PDFs). Never a public URL. Max 512 chars.

fields.name: collected_by
fields.validation_rule: Required. Staff user identifier (PER-054) or SVC-013 service identifier for system-generated evidence. Immutable.

fields.name: psr_relevance
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: supports_eligibility | supports_gross_negligence | supports_vulnerability | neutral | disputed. Analyst classification of evidential weight.

relationships.description: FraudEvidence belongs to one FraudCase via case_id FK.
